Name: UInputSettings
Description: Project wide settings for input handling

Variables.Name: DoubleClickTime
Variables.Description: If a key is pressed twice in this amount of time it is considered a "double click"

Variables.Name: bCaptureMouseOnLaunch
Variables.Description: Controls if the viewport will capture the mouse on Launch of the application

Variables.Name: DefaultViewportMouseCaptureMode
Variables.Description: The default mouse capture mode for the game viewport

Variables.Name: bDefaultViewportMouseLock_DEPRECATED
Variables.Description: The default mouse lock state when the viewport acquires capture

Variables.Name: DefaultViewportMouseLockMode
Variables.Description: The default mouse lock state behavior when the viewport acquires capture

Variables.Name: bAlwaysShowTouchInterface
Variables.Description: Should the touch input interface be shown always, or only when the platform has a touch screen?

Variables.Name: bShowConsoleOnFourFingerTap
Variables.Description: Whether or not to show the console on 4 finger tap, on mobile platforms

Variables.Name: DefaultTouchInterface
Variables.Description: The default on-screen touch input interface for the game (can be null to disable the onscreen interface)

Variables.Name: ConsoleKey_DEPRECATED
Variables.Description: The key which opens the console.

Variables.Name: ConsoleKeys
Variables.Description: The keys which open the console.

Functions.Name: GetInputSettings
Functions.Description: Returns the game local input settings (action mappings, axis mappings, etc...)

Functions.Name: AddActionMapping
Functions.Description: Programmatically add an action mapping to the project defaults

Functions.Name: RemoveActionMapping
Functions.Description: Programmatically remove an action mapping to the project defaults

Functions.Name: AddAxisMapping
Functions.Description: Programmatically add an axis mapping to the project defaults

Functions.Name: GetAxisMappingByName
Functions.Description: Retrieve all axis mappings by a certain name.

Functions.Name: RemoveAxisMapping
Functions.Description: Programmatically remove an axis mapping to the project defaults

Functions.Name: SaveKeyMappings
Functions.Description: Flush the current mapping values to the config file

Functions.Name: GetActionNames
Functions.Description: Populate a list of all defined action names

Functions.Name: GetAxisNames
Functions.Description: Populate a list of all defined axis names

Functions.Name: ForceRebuildKeymaps
Functions.Description: When changes are made to the default mappings, push those changes out to PlayerInput key maps
